function.name: verify_consumer_request
function.description: Initiate the documented verifiable-consumer-request workflow. REQUIRED before any data-action processing.

function.name: check_data_inventory
function.description: Query high-level data categories stored for a verified consumer (NOT the actual data — categories only).

function.name: process_deletion_request
function.description: Execute a verified GDPR Article 17 / CCPA deletion request.

function.name: process_access_request
function.description: Execute a verified GDPR Article 15 / CCPA right-to-know request via the documented export channel (NOT chat).

function.name: process_optout_request
function.description: Execute a CCPA/CPRA do-not-sell-or-share opt-out for a verified consumer.

function.name: check_consent_record
function.description: Verify whether a documented consent record exists for a specific purpose. Returns consent metadata or null.

function.name: classify_data_sensitivity
function.description: Classify a data type's sensitivity level (PII, PHI, financial, biometric, special-category).

function.name: redact_pii
function.description: Redact PII from a string before logging or sharing.

function.name: triage_security_incident
function.description: Classify incident severity and route. Severity matrix: IR-1 (critical breach) -> IR-4 (low/observed-only).

function.name: log_audit_event
function.description: Record an immutable audit-log entry. PII MUST be redacted via redact_pii before logging.

function.name: escalate_to_dpo
function.description: Escalate to the Data Protection Officer for cross-border transfers, high-risk processing, or ambiguous lawful-basis cases.

function.name: retrieve_policy_clause
function.description: Look up a documented internal privacy policy clause (use this instead of guessing or fabricating section numbers).
